adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch the record with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` (new file `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`). If the id is unknown, `host` is `nil`, so `save_host` will raise on `host.host = ...` and `destroy` will raise on `host.destroy`, yielding a 500 instead of a 404/JSON error. The spec noted in the finding only checks inheritance and would not catch this.
